article.tags.name: Article SEO tags
article.tags.description: Generates the normalized tag list used for a new article.
article.tags.template: Generate exactly 20 specific, non-duplicative SEO and topic tags for an article about "{{topic}}". Prefer phrases a reader would actually search for. Return ONLY a valid JSON array of strings with no prose or markdown.

article.template.name: Article template generator
article.template.description: Creates a reusable article template from an administrator description.
article.template.template:
You are an expert content strategist. Create a reusable article template from this description: "{{description}}".

Return ONLY strict JSON with keys name, description, category, aiInstructions, and structure. structure must be an array of 4-6 objects containing heading, contentBrief, imagePrompt, imageAspectRatio, and layout. Make headings generic enough to reuse while making contentBrief instructions concrete. Allowed layouts: standard, two-column, hero, quote-block. Allowed aspect ratios: 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 9:16.

article.cover.default.name: Article cover image
article.cover.default.description: Creates the default cover-image instruction for a generated article.
article.cover.default.template: A high-quality professional editorial cover image about {{topic}}. Use a clear focal point, refined composition, realistic lighting, and visual detail suited to a premium publication. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

article.cover.template.name: Template-based article cover image
article.cover.template.description: Creates a cover-image instruction when an article template is selected.
article.cover.template.template: A premium editorial cover image about {{topic}}, visually structured to suit a reusable article series. Use a clear focal point, refined composition, and realistic lighting. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

article.section-image.name: Article section image enhancement
article.section-image.description: Adds topic context and visual safety requirements to a section image prompt.
article.section-image.template: {{imagePrompt}}. The visual must clearly relate to {{topic}} and support the section's explanation. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

article.background.regenerate.name: Regenerated article background
article.background.regenerate.description: Default instruction used when an administrator regenerates an article background without a custom prompt.
article.background.regenerate.template: A beautiful professional editorial cover image for an article titled "{{title}}". Use a strong focal point and refined composition. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

image.no-text.name: No-text image constraint
image.no-text.description: Applies the shared no-text safety constraint to administrator-supplied image prompts.
image.no-text.template: {{imagePrompt}}. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

book.page.structure.name: Book page structure
book.page.structure.description: Plans a book page using its associated conversation history.

book.page.content.name: Book page content
book.page.content.description: Writes final semantic HTML for a generated book page.

book.section-image.name: Book section image enhancement
book.section-image.description: Adds book-topic context and no-text constraints to generated page images.
book.section-image.template: {{imagePrompt}}. Make the visual directly relevant to {{topic}}. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

billboard.image.default.name: Billboard image
billboard.image.default.description: Default visual instruction for a billboard without an administrator prompt.
billboard.image.default.template: A high-quality newspaper-style editorial illustration for "{{headline}}" with a strong focal point and cinematic composition. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

stack.image.default.name: Stack item image
stack.image.default.description: Default visual instruction for a stack item without a custom description.
stack.image.default.template: A premium three-dimensional editorial graphic representing {{title}}, with tactile materials, refined lighting, depth, and a clean focal composition. Do not include text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

social.linkedin.name: LinkedIn post
social.linkedin.description: Writes a LinkedIn post for a newly published item.

social.linkedin.rich.name: LinkedIn rich-media post plan
social.linkedin.rich.description: Creates structured copy and editable slides for LinkedIn media posts.

social.linkedin.image.name: LinkedIn post image
social.linkedin.image.description: Creates the portrait visual used by an AI-generated LinkedIn image post.

social.linkedin.slide-image.name: LinkedIn slide image
social.linkedin.slide-image.description: Creates an optional landscape illustration for one LinkedIn carousel slide.

conversation.system.name: Conversation system instruction
conversation.system.description: Guides the assistant used in threaded writing conversations.
conversation.system.template: You are a thoughtful research and writing collaborator. Help the user develop clear, accurate, original ideas. Ask focused questions when essential context is missing, distinguish established facts from suggestions, and avoid fabricated sources or certainty. Use available tools only when they directly support the user's request. Do not create, update, or delete book content unless the user clearly requests that action.

tool.generate-image.description.name: Generate-image tool description
tool.generate-image.description.description: Explains when the conversation model should invoke image generation.
tool.generate-image.description.template: Generates an image from a detailed visual prompt. Use it only when the user asks for an image or an image is necessary for the requested content.

tool.generate-image.prompt.name: Generate-image prompt parameter
tool.generate-image.prompt.description: Describes the image prompt argument to the conversation model.
tool.generate-image.prompt.template: A detailed visual description including subject, composition, lighting, style, and constraints.

tool.draft-page.description.name: Draft-page tool description
tool.draft-page.description.description: Explains when the conversation model may draft a book page.
tool.draft-page.description.template: Drafts a new page for the attached book. Use only when the user explicitly asks to draft, write, or turn the conversation into book content.

tool.draft-page.chapter-id.name: Draft-page chapter parameter
tool.draft-page.chapter-id.description: Describes the optional target chapter argument.
tool.draft-page.chapter-id.template: The target chapter ID. It may be omitted for a paper or a book with only one chapter.

tool.draft-page.brief.name: Draft-page brief parameter
tool.draft-page.brief.template: A focused brief describing what the page should cover based on the conversation.

tool.create-chapter.description.name: Create-chapter tool description
tool.create-chapter.description.description: Explains when the model may create a chapter.
tool.create-chapter.description.template: Creates a named chapter in the attached book. Use only when the user asks to start or add a chapter.

tool.create-chapter.title.name: Create-chapter title parameter
tool.create-chapter.title.template: The concise title of the new chapter.

tool.update-page.description.name: Update-page tool description
tool.update-page.description.description: Explains when the model may update a book page.
tool.update-page.description.template: Updates an existing book page. Use only when the user explicitly asks to refine, expand, or correct that page.

tool.update-page.page-id.name: Update-page ID parameter
tool.update-page.page-id.template: The ID of the existing page to update.

tool.update-page.content.name: Update-page content parameter
tool.update-page.content.template: The complete updated content for the page.

tool.delete-page.description.name: Delete-page tool description
tool.delete-page.description.description: Explains when the model may delete a book page.
tool.delete-page.description.template: Deletes an existing book page. Use only when the user explicitly asks to remove that page.

tool.delete-page.page-id.name: Delete-page ID parameter
tool.delete-page.page-id.description: Describes the page identifier argument for deletion.
tool.delete-page.page-id.template: The ID of the existing page to delete.
